description: Land Title Settlement Department - Induragara, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510108 (23/871)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details about land ownership, property boundaries, cadastral maps, mortgages, and encumbrances. The content is focused on land and property-related administrative matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title settlements.
